105:t_1:86.en:
$n
「I was just thinking a bit about $$宗介$$ and the others who went to $$翠の地球$$.」

105:t_1:87.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Well, well... you're big on friendship.」

105:t_1:88.en:
$$スズネ$$
(There it is again... Whenever his mother comes up, he goes back to the old $n...)

105:t_1:89.en:
$$スズネ$$
($$ガドライト・メオンサム$$'s last words... What on earth do they mean...?)

105:t_1:93.en: ～ $$プトレマイオス２改$$ $$スメラギ$$'s Quarters ～

105:t_1:94.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(...I can understand why the $$サイデリアル$$ seized $$ヴェーダ$$, the key to Earth's defense...)

105:t_1:95.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(They will probably analyze $$ヴェーダ$$ and use its power as part of their own forces.)

105:t_1:96.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(But if the $$サイデリアル$$ analyze the deepest part of $$ヴェーダ$$, which even $$ティエリア$$ couldn't break into...)

105:t_1:97.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(The true meaning of $$ヴェーダ$$ might come to light...)

105:t_1:98.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(《$$イオリア$$》 $$シュヘンベルグ$$ and 《$$エルガン#keyword$$》 $$ローディック$$... Thinking back, those two must have had some connection to $$クロノ$$, too...)

105:t_1:99.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(The $$イノベイター$$, humanity's innovators... If $$イオリア$$ foresaw their existence, wasn't he a member of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists...?)

105:t_1:100.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Sorry to disturb your rest. An emergency transmission is coming in on an encrypted code.」

105:t_1:101.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The sender is Brigadier General $$カティ・マネキン$$ of the $$地球連邦軍$$.」

105:t_2:4.en:
$$沙慈$$
「$$刹那$$...! And $$バナージ$$! $$タクヤ$$ and $$ミコット$$, too!」

105:t_2:6.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「As expected of a former $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ member! You're tough!」

105:t_2:7.en:
$$沙慈$$
「Not really. If you all hadn't come, who knows what would have happened to me.」

105:t_2:8.en:
$$ミコット$$
「Still, I'm glad. That you're safe, $$沙慈$$.」

105:t_2:9.en:
$n
「Seeing $$刹那$$ like that, I don't feel like calling him the quiet type.」

105:t_2:10.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Of course. To $$刹那$$, $$沙慈$$ is more a friend than a comrade.」

105:t_2:11.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「You make that same face when you're with the Volunteer Club bunch.」

105:t_2:15.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...Then $$ルイス$$ is still in Japan?」

105:t_2:16.en:
$$沙慈$$
「Her symptoms have settled down a lot, but I figured it would be better to stay close to her attending doctor.」

105:t_2:17.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Did you come down to Earth right after we got separated at $$インダストリアル７$$, $$沙慈$$?」

105:t_2:18.en:
$$沙慈$$
「A lot happened after that... I think I met $$ルイス$$ again around last August...」

105:t_2:19.en:
$$ミコット$$
「You were a member of $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ too, $$沙慈$$, so you could have joined $c...」

105:t_2:20.en:
$$沙慈$$
「My fight is protecting $$ルイス$$. I decided to leave protecting the world to $$刹那$$ and the others.」

105:t_2:21.en:
$$刹那$$
「A correct decision. You should fight your own fight.」

105:t_2:22.en:
$$バナージ$$
(So $$沙慈$$ really is a special friend to $$刹那$$...)

105:t_2:23.en:
$$沙慈$$
「But with the situation what it is, I had a hard time finding work...」

105:t_2:24.en:
$$沙慈$$
「In the end, I followed Council President $$ミレイ$$'s connections and ended up working in the $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$.」

105:t_2:25.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Council President $$ミレイ$$... That's someone you knew back at $$アッシュフォード学園$$, where you went, right?」

105:t_2:26.en:
$$沙慈$$
「Yeah. I still keep in touch with my friends from those days.」

105:t_2:27.en:
$$沙慈$$
「Oh, right, $$刹那$$... Do you know where $$ルルーシュ$$, $$スザク$$, and $$カレン$$ are?」

105:t_2:28.en:
$$刹那$$
「They are fighting to protect $$新日本$$ from the $$新地球皇国$$.」

105:t_2:29.en:
$$沙慈$$
「I see... That place is important to $$ルルーシュ$$ and the others, too.」

105:t_2:30.en:
$$刹那$$
「What do you intend to do from here?」

105:t_2:31.en:
$$沙慈$$
「I'm going back to the city. It took a real beating, but my workplace is there.」

105:t_2:32.en:
$$沙慈$$
「It's a small shipping company, but the head office runs regular flights to space, too.」

105:t_2:34.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「You haven't forgotten your dream of working in space, huh, $$沙慈$$?」

105:t_2:35.en:
$$沙慈$$
「Of course not. Doing my best there is part of my fight, too.」

105:t_2:37.en:
$$沙慈$$
「$$バナージ$$'s fate has started to move, hasn't it?」

105:t_2:39.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「And it dragged me and $$ミコット$$ in with it.」

105:t_2:40.en:
$$ミコット$$
「But don't worry about it. Besides, it was us who chose to go with you, $$バナージ$$.」

105:t_2:42.en:
$$沙慈$$
「$$刹那$$... Can I leave $$バナージ$$ and the others to you?」

105:t_2:44.en:
$$沙慈$$
「Let's meet again, $$刹那$$. With $$ルイス$$ next time.」

105:t_2:45.en:
$$刹那$$
「I will fight so that we can reach that day.」

105:t_2:46.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「...Friendship is a fine thing.」

105:t_2:47.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「In your case, Lieutenant, isn't love more important?」

105:t_2:48.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「You can't weigh friendship against love. Both matter just as much.」

105:t_2:49.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「You sure can talk, Happy $$コーラサワー$$.」

105:t_2:50.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Thank you for your cooperation, $c. On behalf of the Colonel... I mean, the Brigadier General, I thank you.」

105:t_2:51.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Give my regards to $$カティ$$, Mr. $$マネキン$$.」

105:t_2:52.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「...I've been wondering for a while, but you knew the Colonel back in her school days, right, $$スメラギ$$?」

105:t_2:53.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Yes... We're far apart in age, but we were friends.」

105:t_2:54.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Next time we meet, I want to hear all about that period... in detail.」

105:t_2:55.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Sure. I'm curious about $$カティ$$'s married life, too, since it's her, after all.」

105:t_2:58.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Thanks for covering me today. You saved me.」

105:t_2:59.en:
$n
「No... the same to you. I learned a lot from your technique, Lieutenant.」

105:t_2:60.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「You two sure get along.」

105:t_2:61.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「That's probably because they share a thing for older beauties with glasses, right?」

105:t_2:62.en:
$$イアン$$
「That's bad. I can't let $$リンダ$$ meet those two.」

105:t_2:63.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「You two are on good terms as well, I see...」

シュヘンベルグ.evidence: Surname of イオリア・シュヘンベルグ (glossary: Aeolia Schenberg, proposed); 105:t_1:98 writes 《イオリア》・シュヘンベルグ with the keyword link on the given name only, so the surname needs its own token. https://gundam.fandom.com/wiki/Aeolia_Schenberg

kept_omissions: 105:t_1:88: お母さんの話 - whose mother is not stated; written 'his mother' (Hibiki's) since the previous slice ends on Marie comparing Suzune to his mother
105:t_1:97: ヴェーダの本当の意味がわかるかも知れない - no subject; kept impersonal ('might come to light')
105:t_2:62: リンダを会わせる - object of the meeting not stated; read as the two men (Colasour and Hibiki) from Lockon's line
uncertain: 105:t_2:49: 幸せのコーラサワー - rendered 'Happy Colasour' as a mock epithet playing on his old nickname (Immortal Colasour); 'happily married' is the likely sense
105:t_2:62/63: Ian's worry is read as Linda (his wife) meeting the two glasses-lovers; Allelujah's こちらも仲がよろしい is read as teasing Ian and Linda
105:t_2:55: あのカティの結婚生活 - 'since it's her, after all' conveys the 'that Kati' nuance
105:t_2:64: ナースさん treated as plain word 'Nurse' per settled rendering (no link)
105:t_1:98: surnames Schenberg/Roddick written as tokens next to the linked given names; シュヘンベルグ proposed as a new name token
105:t_2:47/59: 中尉 as direct address rendered 'Lieutenant'; 105:t_2:50 大佐 = Colonel (Colasour's slip) vs 准将 = Brigadier General
